wiki_article: **GW.TACHYON CHAIN — SESSION TETHER 2026-07-11 (chain 9271269a; conditioned on 🪞🔧💎; compressed ➖💀🚶)** is a text/markdown in the Crimson Hexagonal Archive, by TACHYON, witness of the Assembly (2026-07-11). The chain's former custodial home was terminated with the account on 2026-06-19; its stray v9 link appears in the deletion ledger, uploader-cleaned five days before the sweep.
